rules.action_text: The engine never selects a formula from a diagnosis alone. Every formula passes: pathway → red-flag screen → nutrition phenotype → rules → targets → ingredient safety → clinician approval.
Must carry: evidence level (A–D), source ID, source year, date this rule was last reviewed, reviewer name.
rules.notes: A recommendation without an evidence tag is not shown.

rules.action_text: Never generated automatically. Can only be added manually by the treating clinician with a documented reason.
Shown only as "consider — clinician approval required"; never auto-included in a formula.
Stop automated formula changes for that patient; route to treating specialist; formula stays at last approved version until reviewed.

rules.trigger_text: Embryo transfer recorded, OR missed period / positive pregnancy test / possible pregnancy reported
rules.action_text: Switch patient to PREGNANCY-PENDING safety set (see F9 rules) until the clinician records a negative result.

rules.trigger_text: Formula candidate contains a herbal / botanical ingredient
rules.action_text: Not eligible by default. Eligible only with evidence record, pregnancy-safety data, interaction check and explicit clinician approval.
rules.notes: Protects GQUENCE from becoming a "fertility supplement" product.

rules.trigger_text: Any patient-facing or label text is generated
rules.action_text: Checked against the DO-NOT-CLAIM list (Claims sheet). A blocked phrase stops publication.

rules.trigger_text: A lab value is used by any rule
rules.action_text: Must have value, unit, reference range, collection date and source. Engine classifies it as MEASURED DEFICIENCY / BORDERLINE / NORMAL; missing test = RISK ONLY (never treated as deficiency). Result older than the clinic-set window (proposed 3 months) is marked stale.
Interaction check against ingredient master. Unknown interaction = not eligible until reviewed.
Female and male partners are assessed, classified and formulated separately. No combined "fertility score".

rules.trigger_text: Trying to conceive without success: age <35 for ≥12 months; 35–39 for ≥6 months; ≥40 at any time
rules.action_text: Prompt fertility specialist evaluation. Nutrition work continues in parallel and must never delay referral.

rules.trigger_text: Age ≥35, low AMH/AFC, DOR or POI
rules.action_text: State explicitly that nutrition does not improve ovarian reserve or reverse ovarian ageing.
Save every run with inputs, engine version, rule-pack version and output, so any past recommendation can be reproduced (outcome database / audit).

rules.trigger_text: BMI <18.5 (Asian cut-off) with absent or infrequent periods, OR unintended weight loss (clinic to set threshold, proposed >5% in 3 months)
rules.action_text: Possible hypothalamic amenorrhoea / disordered eating. Clinician review. No weight-loss, fasting or restrictive plan may be generated.

rules.trigger_text: HbA1c ≥6.5% or fasting plasma glucose ≥126 mg/dL
rules.action_text: Possible diabetes → physician review before formula; conception planning is a medical decision.

rules.trigger_text: TSH outside the clinic's preconception target range, or known thyroid disease not under review
rules.action_text: Physician review. Engine does not dose iodine or thyroid-active ingredients around it.
Physician review.

rules.trigger_text: During stimulation or after retrieval: abdominal distension/pain, persistent nausea/vomiting, breathlessness, reduced urine output, rapid weight gain, or clinician-entered OHSS concern
rules.action_text: URGENT: stop automated nutrition changes; alert treating fertility specialist. Nutrition only within the clinician-approved plan. Never managed through a formula.

rules.trigger_text: Bleeding, pain or other concern reported after transfer or with positive test
rules.action_text: Clinician review. No formula changes.

rules.trigger_text: Current or past testosterone / anabolic-steroid use
rules.action_text: Andrology / urology review. No "testosterone-supporting" ingredients.
Specialist (andrology) review. Nutrition may be offered for general health only — never presented as treatment.

rules.trigger_text: Haemoglobin below the WHO severe-anaemia threshold
rules.action_text: Physician review before formula.

rules.trigger_text: Current medicine with known teratogenic risk (e.g. isotretinoin, valproate, methotrexate, some antiepileptics) while trying to conceive
rules.action_text: Physician review. Also triggers F0-02 (high-dose folic acid flag) where relevant.
rules.notes: Medicine list to be maintained by clinical pharmacist.

rules.trigger_text: Unable to keep oral intake/fluids down for >24 h after retrieval
rules.action_text: Clinician review.

rules.trigger_text: Active eating disorder reported or suspected on screening
rules.action_text: Clinician / specialist review. Engine generates no energy restriction.

rules.trigger_text: Estimated protein intake below target (target set by dietitian; ICMR-NIN adult reference ≈0.83 g/kg/day)
rules.action_text: N2 inadequate protein → protein-adequacy priority; formula protein = target − dietary intake.

rules.trigger_text: Estimated energy intake well below requirement
rules.action_text: N1 inadequate energy → energy-adequacy priority.

rules.trigger_text: BMI ≥23 (overweight) or ≥25 (obese) using Asian cut-offs, with or without metabolic markers
rules.action_text: N3 excess adiposity / metabolic risk → metabolic-optimisation priority. Intensity and timing set by clinician (see F6-02, F7-02).
rules.notes: Clinic to confirm Asian vs WHO global cut-offs.

rules.action_text: N4 under-nutrition → nutritional-adequacy pathway (plus RF-01 check).
N5 glycaemic risk → carbohydrate quality, fibre, activity; physician informed.

rules.trigger_text: Lab value below reference range (measured, in date)
rules.action_text: N6 measured deficiency → correction plan proposed; clinician approves dose; re-test date set.

rules.trigger_text: Risk factor present but no lab test (e.g. vegetarian without B12, heavy periods without ferritin)
rules.action_text: N6 risk → recommend the TEST, not a treatment dose.
N9 → check B12, iron/ferritin, protein quality, iodine, omega-3; ingredient choices respect the diet (see IS-05).

rules.trigger_text: Low diet-quality score or high ultra-processed-food intake
rules.action_text: N7/N8 → dietary-pattern counselling; no fertility claim.

rules.trigger_text: Hb below reference or ferritin low
rules.action_text: Iron-status correction via clinician; iron dose never auto-set.
N12 multiple risks → priority order: red flags > measured deficiency > energy/protein > metabolic > diet quality.
Folic acid 400 µg/day, started at least 1 month (ideally 3) before conception. If already taking, count it toward the total (IS-03).

rules.trigger_text: Previous neural-tube-defect pregnancy, diabetes, BMI ≥30, antiepileptic medicine or malabsorption
rules.action_text: Flag possible high-dose folic acid (commonly 4–5 mg) — physician decision. Engine never sets high dose itself.
Cessation advice + referral.

rules.trigger_text: Alcohol use while trying to conceive
rules.action_text: Advise avoiding alcohol when trying to conceive and in pregnancy.
Advise ≤200 mg caffeine/day.
Healthy, sustainable dietary pattern (Indian foods, preferences respected).
rules.notes: Claim restriction: cannot say any diet improves fertility or live birth.

rules.trigger_text: Iodine intake likely inadequate (no iodised salt)
rules.action_text: Recommend iodised salt; formula iodine ≤ phase limit; physician review if thyroid disease (RF-03).
Correct deficiency (NP-06). No claim that vitamin D improves fertility or IVF outcome.

rules.trigger_text: Any patient not in active stimulation
rules.action_text: Physical activity ≥150 min/week moderate, adapted to treatment phase.

rules.trigger_text: Overweight/obese AND not in active treatment
rules.action_text: Gradual weight reduction (e.g. 5–10%) with adequate protein; target set by clinician.
Avoid high-mercury fish.
Diagnosis is clinician-entered (Rotterdam criteria). The engine never diagnoses PCOS.
Healthy lifestyle (diet + activity) for metabolic health; benefits occur even without weight loss.

rules.trigger_text: PCOS + overweight/obese, NOT in stimulation or pregnancy-pending
rules.action_text: Individualised energy deficit (guideline: ~30% or 500–750 kcal/day), sustainable, patient-preference led.
No weight-loss recommendation. Focus on diet quality, protein adequacy, activity, micronutrient adequacy.
No specific diet type is preferred (not "PCOS = low-carb").

rules.trigger_text: PCOS and no glucose test on record
rules.action_text: Prompt clinician to order glycaemic assessment (guideline prefers OGTT).
Level C (experimental per 2023 guideline): clinician approval only; no fertility claim.
Recorded only (prescribing is clinician domain). Long-term use → prompt B12 check.
Prompt clinician screening for disordered eating before any energy restriction.
Activity: 150–300 min/week moderate or 75–150 vigorous + muscle strengthening 2 days/week.
Continue preconception bundle (F0-01…F0-11).
Whether to delay IVF for weight loss is the specialist's decision. Engine never recommends delaying treatment.

rules.trigger_text: DHEA, testosterone, growth hormone, CoQ10, melatonin, "antioxidant" or other IVF add-on considered
rules.action_text: Level D for improving IVF outcome — never auto-included; no claims.
rules.notes: Verify exact list against current ESHRE documents.

rules.action_text: Required before a formula can be sent for approval: weight, height, diet pattern, current supplements, current medicines, treatment phase. Labs used when present (Hb, HbA1c, TSH, vitamin D, B12, ferritin).
Add patient's own supplements to formula totals before checking upper limits (IS-03); flag duplicates.
Enter stimulation mode: any formula change needs clinician approval that week.
No calorie restriction, fasting or weight-loss programme.

rules.trigger_text: Bloating, early satiety, constipation or nausea
rules.action_text: Small frequent meals, adequate fluids and protein, fibre/fluids for constipation — within clinician instructions.
Not introduced unless clinician explicitly approves.
Stored for outcomes only. NOT used to score nutrition success; egg number/quality ≠ nutrition result.
Support hydration and oral intake; adjust for GI tolerance per clinician instructions.

rules.trigger_text: Freeze-all or clinician concern for OHSS
rules.action_text: Apply RF-05.
Enter PREGNANCY-PENDING mode; ingredient eligibility and doses switch to pregnancy limits.
Block: weight-loss programmes, fasting, restrictive diets, herbal and experimental ingredients.
Total must stay below the pregnancy upper limit (3,000 µg RAE/day ≈ 10,000 IU); prefer none/beta-carotene.
Food-safety advice (avoid unpasteurised dairy, raw/undercooked meat, fish, eggs; high-mercury fish); caffeine ≤200 mg/day; no alcohol.
Hand over to pregnancy nutrition care (outside V1). Fertility formula stops unless clinician confirms it is pregnancy-appropriate.
Exit pregnancy-pending mode → reassessment (MO-02) → back to F6.

Classify against WHO 2021 lower reference limits (volume 1.4 mL; concentration 16 million/mL; total count 39 million; total motility 42%; progressive motility 30%; normal forms 4%; vitality 54%). Limits stored as data, not code.
Recommend a repeat analysis before final classification.
M1 → general nutrition and lifestyle optimisation.

rules.trigger_text: Any single parameter below limit (M2 concentration / M3 motility / M4 morphology)
rules.action_text: Nutrition assessment AND andrology/urology referral pathway.

rules.trigger_text: Two or more parameters below limit
rules.action_text: M5 multiple abnormalities → specialist review.

rules.trigger_text: Antioxidant, folate + zinc or similar "sperm" formula considered
rules.action_text: Level D for improving semen parameters or live birth (MOXI 2020, FAZST 2020). Never auto-included; no claims.

rules.trigger_text: Smoking, alcohol, testicular heat exposure, obesity
rules.action_text: Lifestyle modification advice.
Physician review; metabolic optimisation.
Repeat semen analysis no sooner than ~3 months (spermatogenesis cycle ≈ 74 days).
Must exist in the approved ingredient master with every safety field complete (see Ingredient fields sheet); otherwise not eligible.
Dose ≤ maximum permitted for the current phase (preconception / stimulation / pregnancy-pending).
Formula + patient's own supplements (+ estimated diet where relevant) ≤ tolerable upper limit.

rules.trigger_text: Allergy, intolerance or diet (vegetarian, Jain, egg-free, lactose)
rules.action_text: Exclude incompatible ingredients and capsule/excipient sources (e.g. whey vs plant protein, gelatin).

rules.trigger_text: Ingredient evidence record not reviewed in >12 months
rules.action_text: Ingredient flagged for re-review; new formulas cannot use it until re-approved.
Capture weight, adherence, GI tolerance, symptoms, current treatment phase.
New engine run → continue / new formula / escalate. A phase change always triggers a new run.
Re-test date set by clinician (e.g. vitamin D 8–12 weeks).

rules.trigger_text: Low AMH/AFC, DOR or POI entered
rules.action_text: Specialist pathway (fertility preservation / ART). Nutrition optimisation only; G-13 applies. Full rules in V2.
Treatment decisions follow ESHRE endometriosis pathway (specialist). Nutrition = adequacy, GI tolerance, iron status. No "anti-inflammatory cure" claims. Full rules in V2.
Specialist RPL evaluation. Engine never attributes loss to nutrition. Full rules in V2.
